entities.name: UniProt:Q9WYY4
observations: The supplied 577-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed Thermotoga maritima proline--tRNA ligase Q9WYY4 (100% identity and coverage; exact sequence hash match).
Catalyzes proline activation by ATP to Pro-AMP, then transfer of proline to tRNA(Pro); EC 6.1.1.15.
Annotated alanine-editing activities include tRNA-independent hydrolysis of Ala-AMP and deacylation of mischarged Ala-tRNA(Pro).

entities.name: Prolyl-tRNA synthesis
observations: Net reaction: tRNA(Pro) + L-proline + ATP = L-prolyl-tRNA(Pro) + AMP + diphosphate (Rhea:14305; EC 6.1.1.15).
